faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions I get most

q1.question: Do you work with clients outside Cameroon?
q1.answer: Yes, absolutely. I work remotely with clients all over the world. With clear communication, regular check-ins and transparent project management (Git, demos, documentation), distance is never an obstacle. I adapt to time zones and deliver structured, tracked and reliable work.

q2.question: Can you do integrations (Mobile Money and other apps)?
q2.answer: Yes. I integrate Mobile Money APIs (MTN MoMo, Orange Money), payment gateways, stablecoins (USDT/USDC on Ethereum and Tron) as well as third-party services (CRM, Notion, REST APIs). I handle both the front-end and back-end sides of these integrations.

q3.question: Can you take over an already-started project?
q3.answer: Yes. I can take over an existing codebase. I first analyze the architecture and technical debt, then stabilize, document and evolve the project cleanly — without needlessly rewriting everything.

q4.question: Do you deliver deployment too?
q4.answer: Yes. I deliver all the way to production: server configuration (VPS, Docker, Nginx), CI/CD, domain name, HTTPS and monitoring. You get a live, working application, not just code.
